_scalarComment: Round-9 battery-scalar PROBES (not accepted gates), all recorded from the W7 packed-scoring battery (docs/strata-view-w7-packed-scoring-battery.md 'Per-arm scalars'). Three families: (1) hullPenetrationsProbe — a NON-NORMATIVE penetration probe (W7 edge-vs-hull-frame counter, 2px pad, hull frames only). It is NOT the normative M-H hard gate, whose exact-zero vector also covers leaf-outside-hull, sibling-hull overlap, interleaved band Y-intervals, arrows crossing an UNRELATED CARD INTERIOR, and left-of-source targets (rcll-v2-gate-family-v3.2-proposal.md:42); the normative M-H exact-zero counter remains OUTSTANDING as a round-9 prerequisite. (2) batteryCrossings — an M-TCR battery-scalar probe. (3) sharpShare — an M-ANG battery-scalar probe. Every cell is kind='report-observation': a provenance-recorded MEASUREMENT that asserts NOTHING (claimedStatus MUST be REPORT; the test enforces it), so no edited value can mint a PASS. Improvement direction is hard-coded per metric in code (all three lower-is-better), never read from the cell. Comparators are given by baselineRef (the id of another cell in the v2→I→P chain) and resolved by the test — never a duplicated number. Upgrading a probe to a real PASS/PARITY/FAIL claim requires kind='comparative', which the test rejects until a pinned scalar artifact (path + sha256) exists.
